title: Pickleball Ash
lyrics:
[Intro – low industrial hum, distant tribal drums rising slow, wind-like synth breeze]
Michele on the court… pickleball high in the sky…
Wind in her favor… feel the breeze…
¡SMASH IT! ¡Vamos Michele! Fast steps, let’s go!
[Verse 1]
We walked where restless voices rise
Wounded hearts and guarded eyes
They asked if power was made by will
Or if it stands there, quiet still
They said that doubt has filled the room
That focus is weak and strength will bloom
For just one point then fade away
Like ash that cannot choose to stay
[Chorus – massive industrial drop, soaring distorted vocals, layered tribal chants]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame
Call her to train hard, not stay the same
When every shot says none is right
Michele still smashes, smashes, smashes!
Zynthio court — ¡Vamos! She smashes!
[Verse 2]
Some wear a smile with hollow grace
A laughing void behind the face
They say that play is random air
Then ache when points are not still there
They want a game with no command
No higher focus, no steady hand
Yet cry unfair when trust is torn
As if pure drive can still be born
[Chorus – even heavier, glam-rock guitars slicing through]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame
Call her to train hard, not stay the same
When every shot says none is right
Michele still smashes, smashes, smashes!
Zynthio court — ¡Vamos! She smashes!
[Verse 3 – Michele’s Pickleball Smash & Fast Step verse]
Love is not soft when the fight runs deep
Michele steps up with fast feet that leap
Her pickleball way up high in the sky
It’s talking to her, she hears the reply
Wind in her favor, timeless and true
Breeze brushes her face, eyes locked on the view
She thinks she might… she thinks she may… yes, all signs are clear
It’s saying ¡SMASH IT! — go for it, fast steps right here!
[Bridge – whispered ritual vocals, glitchy industrial break building to triumphant energy]
Get to the net, hold the line, take multiple balls on your way
Hot shoe shuffle, use what you got, see it coming
Hot shoe shuffle then stop! Little creep, take it slow
Hot shoe shuffle to the line — make ’em weep!
Pressure’s on! She’s in control! She’s in position to roll!
¡Ba-na-roll! ¡Ba-na-roll! ¡Ba-na-roll, roll, roll!
Michele on it… she’s on a roll… ¡Controla! Fast steps, smash it!
[Final Chorus – full emotional explosion, trance drop + tribal roar, pickleball “smash” drum hits]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame
Call her to train hard, not stay the same
When every shot says none is right
Michele still smashes, smashes, smashes!
Zynthio court — ¡Vamos Michele! She’s in overdrive!
[Outro – slow tribal fade into hopeful electronic resolve, wind synths + whispered mantra]
Through every drill, through every night
She holds the court… the court… the court
Today she owns the battle with her fast steps and might
Michele awake… forever on the court
Hand in hand…
¡SMASH IT! Fast steps shining bright! ¡Ba-na-roll!
